name: Trenmaxxrr Hacks
description: Custom hacks, each one toggleable in this mod's settings.

show-menu-button.name: Show menu button
show-menu-button.description: Adds a button to the main menu that confirms the mod is loaded.

input-buffer.name: Input buffer (F6)
input-buffer.description: Lets F6 cycle the input buffer in levels: off, 2, 4, 8, 16 ticks (wave capped at 8). Works in every gamemode except platformer and vertical sections, and also lets go of a held click early (wave and ship) if holding would crash you. It starts off every time you open GD, and an on-screen label always shows while it's on.
